DO NOT BOTHER
Aug 2024 • Couples
After looking at the menu online my husband and I caught an uber to Le Monde Steak tonight. 
When we arrived it was early so not busy at all. 
I asked for a cold beer and soda water. Sorry, both were hot! And I am not drinking beer with ice! Not a good start!
On the table there was a special ...combo for 169K ( soup, steak and ice-cream) - I thought that's me ) I said medium to well done steak please.
My husband ordered soup and pasta.
Our meals arrived ...yep, everything at once 🤷‍♀️ seriously.. so as we ate our soups we watched our other meals go cold 🥴 
My steak was medium rare so rather than complain, my husband decided to swap..... rather than send it back.... his pasta was so al dente he was not happy either. It was JUST edible to me.
The bill arrived ... we were charged 249K instead of 169K also charged for desert and soup. 
Just an awful experience over all. Will never return! 

I would suggest you find an alternative restaurant for sure.

Mediocre food, but delightful waitress.
Dec 2022 • Friends
It's difficult to evaluate this restaurant. We had a waitress who was amazingly honest about the food. It is extremely rare to hear a waitress, when asked about their steak, say that it is sinewy and tough to eat, whilst remaining with a wide smile all the time. We spent at least 15 minutes chatting with her about all the various options on the menu, along with a lot of laughter. Without her, the meal would have been a big disappointment. They say it is a French restaurant, but the (tough) steaks are from the USA and France, whilst the supposedly tender steak is from Japan, whilst the dessert included in the steak combo is Italian. In addition, there is an English telephone box in the middle of the restaurant.

The food was mediocre, at best, the only saving grace being our upbeat waitress, who was wonderful. I suspect that there have been so many complaints about the quality of the beef that the waitresses feel that honesty is the best policy, which is refreshing to see. Unless the restaurant changes its menu, its source of beef and probably its chef, then it will not be open for long. 

5 stars for our waitress and a maximum of 2 stars out of 5 for the food.

It took a while to get served by the kind, yet super amateur waiters: we asked for premium steaks. "Sold out, so sorry!". Duck fillet. "Sold out, really so sorry!". Gratinated rice "Oh, sir, so, so, so, sorry, but sold out also". So we went for their best quality Vietnamese steak, and insisted on getting it cooked medium. My two guests couldn't even chew it!
